title: Perform Operator Station Daily Preventive Maintenance Inspection (Controller, Stacklights, Chute Debris)
summary: Perform a daily preventive maintenance inspection of the OptiSweep operator station by checking the controller for visible damage, confirming the stacklights are operational, and ensuring the chute area is free of debris such as stuck labels.
when_to_use: Use this procedure for the daily preventive maintenance inspection of the OptiSweep operator station to verify it is safe to operate (controller condition, stacklights operational, and chute free of debris such as stuck labels).
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: Perform the visual/physical inspection at the operator station and escalate if any required condition is not met (controller damage, non-operational stacklights, or chute debris).
safety_notes: If you find controller damage, non-operational stacklights, or chute debris (e.g., stuck labels), stop the inspection and escalate to maintenance support rather than continuing operation.
access_or_tools_needed: Physical access to the operator station

external_references: Lifecycle Performance Services (LPS) contact guidance for tipper-related maintenance: 888-444-4647

Stacklight photo (visual reference for the stacklight assembly).

steps.title: Inspect the operator station controller for visible damage
steps.purpose: Verify the controller is not visibly damaged before the station is used.
steps.instruction: At the operator station, visually inspect the controller for any visible damage (e.g., cracks, loose components, or other physical damage).
steps.expected_result: The controller shows no visible damage.
steps.healthy_condition: No visible damage is observed on the controller.
steps.failure_condition: Visible damage is observed on the controller.

actions.label: Visual controller inspection
actions.exact_action: Inspect the operator station for Damage to the controller.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Inspect the operator station for the following: Damage to the controller. Stacklights are operational. Chute is free of debris (e.g., stuck labels).

steps.title: Verify operator station stacklights are operational
steps.purpose: Confirm the stacklights are functioning as required for safe operation.
steps.instruction: At the operator station, observe the stacklights and confirm they illuminate/operate as expected (i.e., they are operational).
steps.expected_result: Stacklights are operational (they illuminate/operate as expected).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Inspect the operator station for the following: Damage to the controller. Stacklights are operational. Chute is free of debris (e.g., stuck labels).

steps.title: Inspect the chute area for debris (e.g., stuck labels)
steps.purpose: Ensure the chute is clear so debris does not interfere with operation.
steps.instruction: Inspect the operator station chute area and confirm it is free of debris such as stuck labels.
steps.expected_result: Chute area is clear with no stuck labels or other debris present.
steps.healthy_condition: No debris (e.g., stuck labels) is present in the chute area.
steps.failure_condition: Debris is present in the chute area (e.g., stuck labels).

actions.label: Visual chute debris check
actions.exact_action: Chute is free of debris (e.g., stuck labels).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Inspect the operator station for the following: Damage to the controller. Stacklights are operational. Chute is free of debris (e.g., stuck labels).

steps.title: Stop inspection and escalate if any required condition is not met
steps.purpose: Prevent unsafe operation by escalating when inspection findings indicate a problem.
steps.instruction: If you find controller damage, non-operational stacklights, or chute debris (e.g., stuck labels), stop the inspection and escalate to the appropriate maintenance support. For tipper-related maintenance, contact Lifecycle Performance Services (LPS) at 888-444-4647.
steps.expected_result: Inspection is stopped and maintenance support is contacted/escalated due to the identified issue.
steps.healthy_condition: No escalation is needed because all inspection checks pass.
steps.failure_condition: Inspection continues despite controller damage, non-operational stacklights, or chute debris.

actions.label: Escalate to maintenance support
actions.exact_action: If any damage, non-operational stacklights, or chute debris is found, stop the inspection and escalate to the appropriate maintenance support.
